name: Jordan
title: Holidays in Jordan
intro: Petra's rose-red city, a night under the stars in Wadi Rum and floating in the Dead Sea. Here's what Jordan is like with the family and when to go.

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 2 to 3 hrs ahead of the UK

facts.label: Entry
facts.value: Visa needed, via the Jordan Pass

facts_note: The Jordan Pass covers the visa and Petra entry. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: March to May and October to November are best, warm by day and cool at night. Summer is very hot in Petra and the desert. Winter can be cold and wet, with snow possible in the hills, though Aqaba stays warm.

things.name: Petra
things.blurb: Walk through a narrow gorge to the Treasury. Climb 800 steps to the Monastery if legs allow.

things.name: Wadi Rum
things.blurb: Jeep rides through red desert and a night in a Bedouin camp.

things.name: Dead Sea
things.blurb: Float in water so salty you can't sink. Keep it out of eyes and cuts.

things.name: Aqaba
things.blurb: Snorkel coral reefs in the Red Sea, close to the beach.

things.name: Wadi Mujib
things.blurb: Wade up a canyon river. Open roughly April to October, with age limits.

things.name: Jerash
things.blurb: One of the best-kept Roman cities anywhere, with chariot shows.

faqs.question: Is Jordan good for a family holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes, for families who like adventure and history. Jordanians are very welcoming to children. Check the latest GOV.UK travel advice before booking, as it covers the wider region.

faqs.question: How many nights do you need?
faqs.answer: Seven or eight nights covers Petra, Wadi Rum, the Dead Sea and a beach day in Aqaba.

faqs.question: Do UK families need a visa?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most visitors buy the Jordan Pass online before travel, which includes the visa and entry to Petra and other sites. Check GOV.UK for the current rules.

faqs.question: How much walking is there at Petra?
faqs.answer: A lot. It's about four kilometres to the Treasury and back, and much more to explore. Donkeys and carts can help tired legs.
